name: Étienne de Callataÿ
detail: Advocates real estate property tax reform, capital gains tax, and tax simplification, but explicitly opposes standalone net wealth taxation and warns against capital flight.

name: Vincent Van Peteghem
detail: As Minister of Finance proposed broad tax reform including dual income tax and reform of the securities account tax, but opposed general net wealth taxation.

name: Georges-Louis Bouchez
detail: Leader of MR (Mouvement Réformateur); vigorously opposes any wealth tax (impôt sur la fortune / miljonairstaks), calling it punitive and economically damaging.

name: Bart De Wever
detail: Leader of N-VA; vehemently opposes net wealth taxation or a millionaires' tax, calling it 'volksbedrog' and arguing it drives capital flight and harms Flemish families and entrepreneurs.

name: CD&V
detail: Flemish Christian-democrats; favour capital income taxation (vermogenswinstbelasting) and dual income tax, but explicitly oppose standalone net wealth taxation (vermogensbelasting).

name: Benoît Piedboeuf
detail: Leader of MR parliamentary group in the Chamber; vigorously opposes wealth taxation or taxes on large fortunes, arguing it penalises work and entrepreneurship.

name: Peter De Roover
detail: N-VA parliamentary leader; vehemently opposes net wealth taxation, warning against excessive tax burdens and capital flight.
